HowToOrder.title: How to order
HowToOrder.subtitle: From cart to confirmed, without losing your place.
HowToOrder.description: Your cart, chosen payment method, and confirmed delivery details are kept together when you continue to verification.
HowToOrder.step1Description: Browse the catalogue, select an available option, then review every item in your cart before continuing.
HowToOrder.step2Description: Add your name and email, then choose pickup or confirm a real delivery location. No customer account is required.
HowToOrder.step3Description: Select recharge from store, recharge online, or Bitcoin deposit. The server locks the current cart, total, currency, and selected payment method together.
HowToOrder.step4Description: All Verification opens with your real order already loaded. Submit the recharge codes or complete the Bitcoin invoice; delivery matching starts only after payment is confirmed.
HowToOrder.verificationSubtitle: The page already knows your order.
HowToOrder.verificationDescription: When checkout creates your secure order intent, All Verification receives the real items, total, currency, customer details, payment choice, partner, and confirmed location. Recharge codes remain empty by design.
HowToOrder.paymentDescription: Recharge codes are securely attached to the order. Bitcoin progresses only after provider and blockchain confirmation.
HowToOrder.rechargeFromStoreDescription: Use a code bought in person.
HowToOrder.rechargeOnlineDescription: Buy a code from a listed partner.
HowToOrder.afterPaymentDescription: Delivery orders can be matched with a nearby delivery profile and tracked as they move from processing to out for delivery and completed.
